component.name: Rig Hub
component.summary: Rig Nav, Trip Logger, Tandem Slide, Hazmat, Inspection and Weather for drivers

description.p: Desktop version of Rig Hub: Rig Nav truck routing, the Trip Logger (trips, stops, activity pay, shift miles, pay periods that roll over by themselves, reset totals), Weather from the National Weather Service, the Tandem Slide calculator for CAT scale weights, Hazmat Helper (49 CFR 172.101 lookup, placards, and segregation; reference only, not legal advice), and a pre-trip and post-trip truck and trailer inspection report. The slide result is a rule-of-thumb estimate. Always re-scale after pinning. Inspection saves download a copy; the page does not keep the report. Other data is saved on this computer.
Adds Hazmat Helper and the truck and trailer inspection report next to Tandem Slide, Rig Nav, Trip Logger and Weather.
Adds Tandem Slide on the switcher bar, using the same CAT scale calculator as the standalone app. Rig Nav, Trip Logger and Weather stay in place.
Big switcher bar at the top: Home, Rig Nav, Trip Logger, Weather, with the version shown clearly.
